{{Top|leg}}
'''Gopstal''' was the administrative capital of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]]. [[Neuro-Saav Corporation|NeuroSaav]] [[Model 608 Mega'puter]]s were installed in the city and controlled the daily operations of the whole planet.
